events.title: WWE: Road to Survivor Series
events.venue: Akins Ford Arena at the Classic Center
events.blurb: WWE superstars bring a live wrestling card to downtown Athens on Black Friday night, part of the build to Survivor Series: WarGames.
events.blurbEs: Las superestrellas de la WWE traen una noche de lucha libre en vivo al centro de Athens el Black Friday, como antesala de Survivor Series: WarGames.

events.title: Georgia vs. Georgia Tech
events.blurb: Clean, Old-Fashioned Hate comes back to Athens as the Bulldogs host Georgia Tech in the regular-season finale. Kickoff is listed at 3:30 p.m. on ABC.
events.blurbEs: La rivalidad Clean, Old-Fashioned Hate vuelve a Athens: los Bulldogs reciben a Georgia Tech en el cierre de la temporada regular. El partido está programado a las 3:30 p.m. por ABC.

events.title: Winter WonderLights
events.blurb: A half-mile holiday light trail through the botanical garden with timed entry every 30 minutes; kids 3 and under are free. Tickets must be bought online in advance, and parking is free with a shuttle from the Turner Soccer Complex.
events.blurbEs: Un sendero de luces navideñas de media milla por el jardín botánico, con entradas cada 30 minutos; los niños de 3 años o menos entran gratis. Los boletos se compran por internet con anticipación, y hay estacionamiento gratis con transporte desde el Turner Soccer Complex.
events.getThere: Free parking and shuttle at UGA's Turner Soccer Complex, 2330 S. Milledge Ave.

events.title: Athens Farmers Market Holiday Artist Market
events.blurb: The Athens Farmers Market's holiday edition, with 90-plus vendors selling handmade gifts, local crafts, produce and food. A good Small Business Saturday stop.
events.blurbEs: La edición navideña del Athens Farmers Market, con más de 90 vendedores de regalos hechos a mano, artesanías locales, productos frescos y comida. Una buena parada para el Small Business Saturday.

events.title: Georgia Museum of Art
events.blurb: The official state art museum on the UGA campus, free every day it's open. Free timed tickets can be reserved online.
events.blurbEs: El museo de arte oficial del estado, en el campus de UGA, con entrada gratis todos los días que abre. Se pueden reservar boletos gratuitos por internet.
events.getThere: Accessible parking directly beneath the museum at 90 Carlton Street.

events.title: State Botanical Garden of Georgia
events.blurb: Free display gardens and nature trails, with free parking. The grounds close to day visitors at 4 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Jardines y senderos naturales gratis, con estacionamiento gratuito. Los jardines cierran a los visitantes de día a las 4 p.m.
